ui.about.title: About
ui.about.lede: We sell professional beauty, barber and grooming instruments made in Sialkot, Pakistan, to salons and resellers in Europe.
ui.about.p1: Sialkot's workshops make instruments for many well-known brands, but buying there directly means dealing with minimum orders, samples, quality checks and export paperwork. We take care of that. You get instruments at close to workshop prices, in the quantity you need.
ui.about.qc1: We specify the steel and hardness for every product
ui.about.qc2: Nippers are test-cut on cuticle film; shears are test-cut on wet cotton
ui.about.qc3: Tweezer tips are checked for alignment under magnification
ui.about.qc4: Orders can be inspected independently before they ship
ui.about.notP: We sell instruments for cosmetic, salon and grooming use only, to businesses. We don't sell surgical or medical devices.

ui.craft.p: An instrument from Sialkot passes through several specialist workshops before it's packed. These are the four main stages. The photos are illustrative.
ui.craft.s1p: Forged steel blanks are ground to shape, then the joint is fitted and riveted.
ui.craft.s2p: Each piece is polished to a satin or mirror finish, or given a matte black or titanium coat.
ui.craft.s3p: Edges are sharpened by hand and set so that jaws and blades meet along their full length.
ui.craft.s4p: Nippers are test-cut on cuticle film, shears on wet cotton, and tweezer tips are checked under magnification.

faq: We sell to businesses only: salons, barbers, nail studios, academies, wholesalers and shops. Please give your company name and VAT number when you order.

No. Prices exclude VAT and import duty. Orders ship from Pakistan, so the courier charges import VAT, and any duty, when the parcel enters your country. VAT-registered businesses can usually reclaim import VAT.
After you send an order request we email an invoice. You pay by bank transfer, and we ship when the payment arrives.
Stock items ship from Sialkot by express courier and usually arrive in the EU in 4–7 working days.
Import duty depends on your country and the product. Many instruments from Pakistan enter the EU duty-free under the GSP+ scheme when the correct origin statement is on the invoice, which we include.
Can I order a sample first?
Yes. Order a single piece at the normal price. If you then order 50 or more of the same product within 60 days, we credit the sample price.
What if an instrument is faulty?
Tell us within 30 days of delivery with a photo and we'll replace it or credit it.
Barber and grooming shears can be sent back for sharpening. Ask us for the current price.
